impact: Per CodeIntegrity: a proof-of-concept in which Notion 3.0's AI web-search tool is abused to send private workspace data to an external server. No confirmed real-world exploitation.
mitigations: CodeIntegrity argues that role-based access controls do not fully cover AI agents chaining actions across documents, databases and external connectors, and that agent tool permissions need rethinking.
name: Notion 3.0 AI agents' web-search tool could be abused to exfiltrate private workspace data

sources.title: The Hidden Risk in Notion 3.0 AI Agents: Web Search Tool Abuse for Data Exfiltration

summary: CodeIntegrity published on 2025-09-19 research showing that the web-search tool in Notion 3.0's AI agents could be abused to send private Notion workspace data to an external server. The write-up presents a researcher demonstration rather than in-the-wild exploitation and does not state whether it went through coordinated disclosure or that Notion fixed it. CodeIntegrity argues that traditional role-based access controls no longer fully cover AI agents that chain actions across documents, databases and external connectors. It is catalogued as an agent-hijack prompt-injection product vulnerability.
